scope: Cleanup of existing code (D27): remove the MAGSWT grid search and the unverified observables/correlations.py; add orbit_energy_landscape, spin_correlation and to_ladder as their replacements.

removed.code-space/spintoolkit/observables/corre: untested, unwired; per-cell normalization, doubled sublattice phase, sublattice-index typo (stage-4c record)
removed.code-space/spintoolkit/methods/optimizat: opt_method 'MAGSWT'/'magswt' (magswt_for_nbcp) and the find_minimum arguments full_range_search, num_search; requesting MAGSWT raises ValueError pointing to select_on_manifold and orbit_energy_landscape

added.code-space/spintoolkit/methods/state_sel: orbit_energy_landscape, OrbitLandscape: E_cl and optional E_qm along R_n(phi) on any angle grid; axis from the classical Hessian as in select_on_manifold
added.code-space/spintoolkit/observables/struc: spin_correlation (equal-time <S_i S_j> between any sites), to_ladder ((+, -, z) basis); bond_correlations rebuilt on the same helpers

changed.examples/nbcp_ground_state.py: classical search plus select_zero_point (select_on_manifold) instead of MAGSWT
changed.examples/nbcp_state_selection_check.py: records the orbit landscape instead of the MAGSWT comparison (kept in the stage-2b record)
changed.examples/lswt_stage4c_check.py: the comparison with the removed module is kept in the stage-4c record
changed.examples/package_regression_snapshot.py: MAGSWT searches dropped; compare reports baseline leaves of removed methods instead of failing
changed.code-space/tests: MAGSWT grid test replaced by a landscape test; removed-method tests include MAGSWT; 3 correlation tests (Fourier pair with S(k), symmetry and bond consistency, ladder components)

not_kept: real-time correlations and the retarded spectral function (legacy functions) wait for the review of the response conventions in docs/lswt/02-observables; the MAGSWT regularization of solve_lswt is unchanged (D24).

tests.regression_snapshot: 144 leaves compared, maximum difference 0.0; 64 baseline leaves of the removed MAGSWT searches not compared

landscape.summary: NBCP Y/V with J_PD or J_Gamma, 72 angles: E_cl flat (<= 2e-17); sampled E_qm minimum within the grid error of the selected minimum

example_run: NBCP_CONFIG of examples/nbcp_ground_state.py (J_Gamma = 0.1, N = 6): classical ground state Four MSL, select_on_manifold verdict no_degeneracy (classical pinning dominates)
decisions: D27 (2026-09-30): delete observables/correlations.py and move equal-time real-space correlations and ladder components to the new module; delete the MAGSWT grid search, whose purpose (the energy landscape along the classical orbit for NBCP) is served by orbit_energy_landscape.
